title: Verb Tenses - Present and Past
description: Lær de viktigste engelske tidene: present simple, present continuous, past simple og past continuous.
competenceGoals: bruke sentrale mønstre for uttale, ordforråd og setningsoppbygging

content.content:
## Verb-tider (Verb Tenses)

Verb-tider forteller oss **når** noe skjer. Engelsk har mange tider, men i dette kapittelet fokuserer vi på de fire viktigste: present simple, present continuous, past simple og past continuous.

Å velge riktig tid er en av de vanligste utfordringene for norske elever.

content.title: Present Simple (enkel presens)
content.content:
Bruk **present simple** for:
- **Fakta og generelle sannheter**: *"Water boils at 100 degrees."*
- **Vaner og rutiner**: *"I wake up at 7 every day."*
- **Faste situasjoner**: *"She lives in Oslo."*

**Bøyning**: I/you/we/they + verb | he/she/it + verb + **-s**
- *"I **play** football."* / *"She **plays** football."*
- *"They **go** to school."* / *"He **goes** to school."*

**Nektende**: I/you/we/they + **don't** + verb | he/she/it + **doesn't** + verb
- *"I **don't** like spinach."* / *"She **doesn't** like spinach."*

content.title: Present Continuous (presens kontinuerlig)
content.content:
Bruk **present continuous** for:
- **Handlinger som skjer akkurat nå**: *"I am reading a book."*
- **Midlertidige situasjoner**: *"He is staying with friends this week."*
- **Framtidige avtaler**: *"We are meeting tomorrow."*

**Bøyning**: am/is/are + verb + **-ing**
- *"I **am watching** TV."*
- *"She **is sleeping**."*
- *"They **are playing** outside."*

content.title: Eksempel: Present simple vs. present continuous
content.problem:
Hva er forskjellen mellom disse setningene?

a) *"I **read** books."*
b) *"I **am reading** a book."*
content.solution:
a) **Present simple** - dette er en vane/rutine. Personen leser bøker generelt (kanskje som hobby).

b) **Present continuous** - dette skjer akkurat nå, i dette øyeblikket. Personen sitter og leser akkurat nå.

Enkel huskeregel:
- **Present simple** = noe du gjør regelmessig
- **Present continuous** = noe du gjør akkurat nå

exercise.task: Velg riktig tid: present simple eller present continuous?

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "She reads every evening before bed." - present simple for vaner/rutiner.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "Look! It is raining outside right now." - present continuous for noe som skjer nå.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius." - present simple for fakta/naturlover.

hints: Se etter tidsuttrykk: 'every day', 'always' = present simple; 'right now', 'look!' = present continuous.
exercise.solution: Present simple = vaner, fakta, faste situasjoner. Present continuous = noe som skjer nå.

content.title: Past Simple (enkel fortid)
content.content:
Bruk **past simple** for:
- **Avsluttede handlinger i fortiden**: *"I visited Paris last year."*
- **Rekke av hendelser**: *"She woke up, ate breakfast, and left."*

**Bøyning**:
- **Regelmessige verb**: verb + **-ed** (*walked, talked, played*)
- **Uregelmessige verb**: egen form (*went, saw, ate, took*)

**Nektende**: subjekt + **didn't** + grunnform
- *"I **didn't go** to the party."* (ikke: I didn't went)

**Viktige uregelmessige verb i fortid:**

| Grunnform | Fortid | Norsk |
|---|---|---|
| go | went | gå |
| see | saw | se |
| take | took | ta |
| eat | ate | spise |
| write | wrote | skrive |
| give | gave | gi |
| come | came | komme |
| make | made | lage |
| think | thought | tenke |
| buy | bought | kjøpe |
| say | said | si |
| get | got | få |

content.title: Past Continuous (fortid kontinuerlig)
content.content:
Bruk **past continuous** for:
- **Handlinger som pågikk over tid i fortiden**: *"I was reading when the phone rang."*
- **Bakgrunn i fortellinger**: *"The sun was shining and the birds were singing."*

**Bøyning**: was/were + verb + **-ing**
- *"I/he/she/it **was** playing."*
- *"You/we/they **were** playing."*

Ofte brukt sammen med past simple: **past continuous** (bakgrunn) + **past simple** (handling):
- *"I **was watching** TV when my friend **called**."*

content.title: Eksempel: Past simple vs. past continuous
content.problem:
Forklar forskjellen:

a) *"When she arrived, I **made** dinner."*
b) *"When she arrived, I **was making** dinner."*
content.solution:
a) **Past simple + past simple**: Handlingene skjedde etter hverandre. Først kom hun, deretter begynte jeg å lage middag.

b) **Past continuous + past simple**: Jeg holdt allerede på å lage middag da hun kom. Middagslagingen var bakgrunnen, ankomsten var hendelsen.

Past continuous = den pågående handlingen (bakgrunnen)
Past simple = den plutselige hendelsen

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "Yesterday, we went to the cinema." - past simple for avsluttet handling i fortiden.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "I was sleeping when the alarm rang." - past continuous for pågående handling, past simple for den plutselige hendelsen.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "She didn't come to school last Monday." - nektende past simple med didn't + grunnform.

hints: Etter didn't bruker vi alltid grunnformen av verbet.
Past continuous (was/were + -ing) brukes for pågående bakgrunnshandlinger.
exercise.solution: Past simple = avsluttede handlinger. Past continuous = pågående handlinger i bakgrunnen.

content.content:
**Signalord hjelper deg å velge riktig tid:**

| Tid | Signalord |
|---|---|
| Present simple | every day, always, usually, never, often |
| Present continuous | now, right now, at the moment, look! |
| Past simple | yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago |
| Past continuous | while, when, as |

exercise.task: Velg riktig tid for hver setning.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "Right now, I am writing my homework." - present continuous for noe som skjer nå.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "She plays tennis every Saturday." - present simple for vaner/rutiner.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "While I was walking home, I found a wallet." - past continuous for bakgrunn, past simple for hendelse.

exercise.solution: Bruk signalordene til å bestemme hvilken tid som passer.

exercise.task: Skriv en kort fortelling (4-6 setninger) om noe du gjorde i helgen. Bruk både past simple og past continuous.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: Skriv fortellingen din på engelsk. Bruk past simple for hendelsene og past continuous for bakgrunnen.
subTasks.solution: Eksempel: "Last Saturday, I was walking in the park when I saw my friend. She was sitting on a bench and reading a book. I went over and said hello. We talked for an hour, and then we went to a cafe. It was a great day."

hints: Start med å sette scenen (past continuous): The sun was shining, I was walking...
Bruk past simple for hendelsene: I saw, we went, she said...
exercise.solution: Å kombinere past simple og past continuous gjør fortellinger mer levende og detaljerte.

exercise.task: Hva er fortidsformen av disse uregelmessige verbene?
exercise.solution: Uregelmessige verb har egne fortidsformer som du må lære utenat.

content.content:
## Oppsummering

| Tid | Bruk | Eksempel |
|---|---|---|
| Present simple | Vaner, fakta | *She plays tennis.* |
| Present continuous | Skjer nå | *She is playing tennis.* |
| Past simple | Avsluttet fortid | *She played tennis yesterday.* |
| Past continuous | Pågående fortid | *She was playing when I called.* |

**Huskeregelen for fortid:**
- **Past simple** = hendelsen (hva skjedde)
- **Past continuous** = bakgrunnen (hva pågikk)

Øv på uregelmessige verb - de er nøkkelen til å snakke og skrive korrekt om fortiden!
